text: I ratify reclaim:ma_20 on H1, WAIT. The new high livermore notes is not my entry by itself: my read is a retracement by proxy (C7, adx NOT_SERVED) with W and D hh_hl_3 HH/HL and H1 hh_hl_3 LH/LL, so the short cycle is already easing. Buying the break away from the average is what C19 warns against; the first pullback is the defined entry. A Creek pull-in first I could live with; a bare bar_high break I would not. Wrong on a daily close more than 1 ATR under the 20-day average. What would move me: H1 hh_hl_3 turning HH/HL before any pullback.
